caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic-looking bowl with two symmetrical handles, one on each side. The bowl has a wide, open mouth and a gently curving body that tapers slightly to a small circular base. The handles are thin, rounded, and extend horizontally from the sides of the bowl, each curving outward and then forming a small loop at their base where they attach to the bowl. The shading is gradated, ranging from light gray to darker gray, providing the appearance of smooth, reflective metal, with lighter highlights suggesting a light source from above. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color. There is a handwritten signature in the bottom right corner that reads "Amelia Tuccio - 1936."
title: Silver Bowl
